_meta.what: COMMUNITY event calendar + client-version spine from the Exvius Fandom wiki — a HINT, not verification, and NOT shipped game data. Every name/date/period/summary below is the wiki's reading of a live service; the FFBE client itself ships no event schedule (F_BANNER_MST has names and images, no dates).
_meta.source: https://exvius.fandom.com/wiki/Update_Schedule (Global + Japanese update logs), https://exvius.fandom.com/wiki/Version_<X.Y.Z> (one page per global client version), and each linked event page — all via the MediaWiki API (action=parse&prop=wikitext). The HTML routes 403 a scraper; the API does not.

client_under_analysis.note: the v9.0.0 build under analysis shipped on this date per the wiki's own Version page infobox; the marquee art cached by that client therefore dates from 2024-06-30 onward

_meta.region_caveat: region=jp records are the Japanese service's windows, NOT the global client's. Only region=global records are used for marquee_match.
_meta.coverage_caveat: The wiki's Global update log stops at 22-Aug-2024 (30-Oct-2024 carries a single 'End of Service' row and nothing after it) and has no 8th-anniversary-era rows; the JP log runs to Sept-2025. The wiki documents the ORIGINAL run of a 'Fundamental Forces' arc, never a rerun — see each marquee record's caveat. The update log is grouped by SEASON, not by version: the only [[Version X.Y.Z]] labels inside it sit on Feature rows and stop at 6.0.0, so the version spine comes from the Version pages.
_meta.banner_join_basis: marquee_match joins the client's 8 cached banner FILENAMES to the event PAGE TITLES: exact-title only when the squashed banner name equals the squashed title ('full') or is a whole trailing segment of it ('suffix'). A shared-word hit is NOT a match. The wiki publishes no banner ids, so an id-level join is impossible and a title join is all that is claimed.
_meta.end_date_reliability: End dates are UNRELIABLE BY SOURCE. A page's own period line can be inverted (end < start) or multi-year, so `end` is nulled and `end_suspect` set to 'end<start-in-source' or 'multi-year-span'. A dated instance the page does not describe carries end=null, end_basis='row-date-only' and an `occurrence` of earlier-instance / later-instance / row-only — a page states ONE period, so a recurrence is never collapsed into it.

community.unverified_region: this page was NOT reached from the global update log, so its region is not established

events.name: Emperor
events.summary: The ruler of the empire that a rebel army opposes in tales from a distant world. The Emperor stands atop the war-hungry empire of Palamecia, and is a man with no regard for human life. Capable of terrible magic, he summons demonic forces from hell into the mortal realm to destroy the world. After leaving the kingdoms of Deist and Kashuan in ruins, he subjugates the remaining territories around him
